title: Doctrine pick
description: One doctrine a seat picks before a match (GH-1383; design docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-doctrines-design.md §2.2): its faction's base doctrine (data/doctrines/<faction>.json, unchanged) and a closed list of four operations on it (the lead's Q5, 19 Nov 2026: menu remove, menu add, cap and price; no stat patch). Applied by @lions/data's resolveDoctrine/applyDoctrine before addUnitType; the sim never sees this file. `pnpm validate:data` holds the cross-file rules P1-P10 (tools/validate_doctrine.mjs) and the cost-curve bar (tools/doctrine_balance.py; the lead's Q6). Nothing reads a pick at runtime until slice 3 (DOCTRINES_OPEN).

id.description: The pick's id, which is its file's name. The player word is "doctrine"; the code word is "pick" (the lead's Q1).

extends.description: The base doctrine's id, which is its faction. The id's prefix must match (P1).

gives_up.description: The one line that says what this doctrine gives up (the issue's tester criterion).

signature.description: The doctrine's one signature call: a doctrine-gated formation (the lead's Q4), data only. Its file, in data/formations/doctrine/, and the formation schema's `doctrines` field are slice 5's; until then this is an id (P9's slice-1 half).

status.description: No balance claim beyond the cost-curve gate while it reads proposed.
